title: Warm Gooey Brazilian Mincemeat Pie
description: A festive Brazilian dessert featuring mincemeat and a floral twist, perfect for special occasions, this low-glycemic-friendly treat is sure to delight
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together almond flour, coconut sugar, and a pinch of salt
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, melted butter, and rose water
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until well combined
Fold in the mincemeat and orange zest, if using
Pour the mixture into a 9-inch pie dish and bake for 35 minutes
While the pie is baking, prepare the deglaze by whisking together 1 tablespoon of honey and 1 tablespoon of water in a small bowl
After the pie has baked for 30 minutes, brush the deglaze over the top and return to the oven for an additional 5 minutes
Remove the pie from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving warm
